description: Returns a per-record counter, calling a helper first when it is zero. It also increments a second counter for the current index, up to a limit of 120.

name: adjust_offset_by_state_bits
description: When a state bit is set and a flag is clear, adjusts a record offset by plus or minus three depending on a flag. It then loops over frame values, calling helpers and comparing table entries.

name: adjust_offset_then_scan_frames
description: Adjusts a record offset by plus or minus three depending on a flag, then loops over frame values, calling helpers and comparing table entries.

name: toggle_state_flags
description: Toggles a flag byte when a state bit is set, sets a small global to the record index under a condition, sets a second flag when another bit is set, calls a helper and then stores the next frame value.

name: decrement_frame_and_look_up
description: Decrements a frame value in a record. If it stays above a table limit it stores a table value and calls a helper, otherwise it loops calling helpers while comparing table entries.

name: update_sprite_byte_field
description: Looks up a byte in a shared table using a record field and a register byte as the index, stores it in a record field, then calls a helper.

name: update_record_position_with_bounds
description: Adds or subtracts table values to a record's position byte depending on a direction flag, then clamps the result into a fixed range.

name: update_position_from_index
description: Variant that takes its table index from a register. It adjusts the record's position byte by a table value and a constant, applies the position bounds and stores the result.

name: clamp_record_position_bounds
description: Adds a table value to a record's position byte, then applies bounds. Below the lower limit it resets to 17, above the upper limit it sets a fixed value depending on the direction flag, and any value above 207 resets to 16.

name: set_position_from_table_sum
description: Sets a record's position byte from a table sum minus 40, floored at zero, and resets any value above 207 to 16.

name: clamp_position_when_high_index
description: When a shared index is above 174, sets the record's position byte from a table value or a fixed value depending on a direction flag. Any value above 207 then resets to 16.

name: set_position_then_clamp
description: Sets a record's position byte to a fixed constant and resets any value above 207 to 16.

name: call_clear_sprite_attribute_table
description: Calls one helper that zeroes sprite attribute words, then returns.

name: compute_row_offset_times_eighty
description: Returns zero when a shared mode value is eight. Otherwise it multiplies the low byte of the input by 80, the byte stride of one bitplane row.

name: write_dma_control_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show it writes the DMA control register, calls one unnamed routine and is called from the struct-copy routine and six others.

name: init_stream_record_from_source
description: Copies a count and a source pointer into a record, moves saved fields between offsets, zeroes a field in a second structure and points the record at the shared data base.

name: set_bits_except_lowest
description: Returns the input byte with every bit except bit zero set, by ORing it with a constant mask.

name: poll_fire_port_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show it touches the CIA A port register, which carries the fire button bits, and calls one unnamed routine.

name: run_undecoded_single_helper
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show a 12-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine and ran in the reference run.

name: run_undecoded_two_helpers
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show a six-instruction routine that calls two unnamed routines.

name: run_undecoded_single_helper
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show a two-instruction routine that calls one unnamed routine.

name: run_undecoded_single_helper
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not decoded. The facts show a nine-instruction routine, called once, that calls one unnamed routine.

name: reset_title_state_arrays
description: Calls one helper, which the facts identify as the title logo frame routine, then zeroes a series of shared state variables and a block of 16 longwords.

name: initialize_title_arrays
description: Loops 21 times copying a shared table byte into a byte array, writes 31 into a second byte array and clears two word arrays. It then sets two shared variables to 32.

name: preshift_sprite_rows_for_list
description: Writes a three-word entry into a shared list, then loops over rows of source words. Each row is shifted by a bit count taken from a register and the pieces are combined from several bitplane offsets.

name: check_position_range_and_dispatch
description: Returns its inputs unchanged. When a masked value is below 200 and a derived column index lies outside two excluded ranges, it calls a dispatch routine.

name: return_without_effect
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no memory access, register writes or calls, so the routine does nothing when it runs.

name: return_without_effect

name: return_without_effect

name: toggle_table_bit_copy_block
description: Toggles one bit in a table entry chosen by an index register, then copies 120 groups of five longwords from one address to another in a loop. The decoded body is long and only its opening is shown.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: If the destination pointer is non-null, copies 16 longwords from a fixed table offset into it. It then calls a routine through a function pointer.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ssboot:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_sequence
description: Program entry point that calls through a function pointer and a library base, makes further calls, and clears a stored pointer before returning. The facts list a delay helper that counts down to minus one.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ssboot:2:0000
name: process_nonzero_table_entries
description: Loops over a table of words at a fixed address, calling a function pointer for each non-zero global entry and writing words into an output list until a count is reached.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ssboot:2:00AA
name: select_half_or_input_word
description: Returns the input word unchanged unless a flag equals one, in which case it returns half of a second word.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:ssboot:2:00C2
name: mask_with_table_word
description: Looks up a word in a fixed table, using an index doubled into a byte offset, and returns it ANDed with the caller's word.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:0000
name: locate_rnc_block_and_prepare
description: Program entry point that allocates memory through the exec library and walks a linked list until it finds a block with an RNC version one signature, then prepares that block's data pointers. The rest of the decoded code is cut off.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:0124
name: lookup_pair_extract_bits
description: Scans a table of word pairs until a masked value matches, reads a count byte from the matching entry and extracts that many bits from the input. It calls another routine when a byte comparison borrows.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:015E
name: mask_and_conditional_call
description: Masks one word with another and returns the result, unless a byte comparison sets a condition. In that case it calls a helper and returns the helper's word instead.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:016A
name: return_without_effect
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no memory access, register writes or calls, so the routine does nothing when it runs.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:0182
name: build_bit_mask_table
description: Reads a count, fills a stack buffer with values from a helper, then loops to write bit masks and derived values into a table based on a key list.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:hoodlum:0:020A
name: apply_hunk_reloc32_entries
description: Checks for an AmigaDOS RELOC32 block and walks its entries, adding a section base address to each target longword and zeroing the entries as it goes.

key: sensible world of soccer (1994)(renegade)[cr hlm](disk 1 of 2)/Sensible World of Soccer (1994)(Renegade)[cr HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf:MB:0:0000
name: wait_until_flag_bit_clear
description: Spins until bit six of a shared flag clears, then returns.

name: initialize_custom_chips_and_display
description: Opens the graphics library, takes over the system, adjusts the interrupt and DMA control registers, and sets the display window, data fetch and blitter registers. The facts also list copper and bitplane registers.

name: fill_four_stepped_addresses
description: Fills four table entries, each a longword address stored as two words, with the address increasing by 5000 each time.

name: fill_seven_stepped_addresses
description: Fills seven table entries, each a longword address stored as two words, with the address increasing by 264 each time.

name: call_helpers_return_third_result
description: Calls four routines in order and returns the result of the third call.

name: advance_frame_and_wait_blitter
description: Sets frame counters, clears two values when a counter is below 700, and loads a table of address words when another counter is zero. It then calls helpers and waits until the blitter is idle.

name: reset_blitter_state_counters
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, clears a block of state words and counters, then sets fixed values for the next blit.

name: advance_wrapping_counter_array
description: Advances an array of counters one step each, carrying into the next counter when a counter passes its limit of 29, and calls a helper for each step. It also copies a table into the counters.

name: store_seven_words_in_slot
description: Stores seven words from an input list into a slot whose address comes from a counter and a stride. A second layout is used when the counter is above five.

name: advance_flagged_counter
description: When a flag byte from a table is non-zero, calls a helper, advances two counters with wrap-around, then calls a further helper.

name: store_seven_bytes_strided
description: Stores seven bytes from an input buffer into a destination computed from two counters, with a fixed stride of 40 bytes between each byte.

name: start_blit_frame_copy_coords
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, copies three coordinate words into fixed locations, calls several helpers and writes DMA control values around them.

name: scale_three_arrays_fixed_point
description: Scales three arrays of values in place by a fixed-point factor read from a table, using a multiply and a ten-bit shift for each entry.

name: walk_edge_cross_product_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of records, looks up point coordinates from a table for each entry and computes two cross-product terms, storing a result when the terms compare.

name: reset_blitter_parameters
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, clears a set of blitter parameter words, and sets a fixed pointer, modulo and control word.

name: advance_three_wrapping_coordinates
description: Adds stored increments to three coordinate words and wraps each one back by 720 when it passes 719.

name: copy_points_scaled_xy
description: Scales a list of points by a factor and writes the scaled x and y values into two output arrays, copying the third component across.

name: scale_three_components_with_factor
description: Scales a list of points by a factor and writes all three scaled components into three output arrays.

name: set_blitter_pointers_for_frame
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, then loads its source and destination pointers, a modulo and a control word for the next frame.

name: draw_blit_list_entries
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its initial registers, then walks a zero-terminated list of entries and calls a drawing helper for each entry whose flag is set.

name: setup_line_draw_increments
description: Computes the horizontal span between two edge positions against a 64-unit limit, swaps the endpoints when needed and sets up the increments for a line draw.

name: set_blitter_mask_parameters_alt
description: Waits for the blitter, then writes a size word, mask values, a pointer pair and a control word using a different register layout from its neighbour.

name: set_blitter_copy_parameters
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its control word, sets the mask and two pointers from fixed values, then sets the blit size.

name: call_subroutine_four_times
description: Calls one subroutine four times in succession and returns.

name: set_blitter_pointers_from_args
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its size and mask registers, loads its pointers from the two arguments and starts the blit.

name: call_subroutine_four_times
description: Calls one routine four times in succession and returns.

name: call_subroutine_four_times
description: Calls one routine four times in succession and returns.

name: pack_shifted_bits_into_long
description: Shifts the low bit of a value into a packed byte with an offset from a second byte, stores the packed longword at a pointer, and returns the value shifted right by one.

name: read_next_table_entry_wrapping
description: Reads the next six-byte entry from a table, wrapping back to the start when an entry is marked with a negative value, and stores its fields into two state words.

name: copy_triplets_into_three_arrays
description: Copies seventeen groups of three words from a source block into three arrays and advances the third value of each group by a computed offset.

name: store_offset_longs_and_constants
description: Stores a shared value and that value plus a constant into two output longwords, then writes two fixed words.

name: blit_fill_area_with_value
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its control word, mask and size, and fills a rectangle with a value supplied by the caller.

name: scale_three_arrays_by_product
description: Scales arrays of values in place by the product of a per-entry factor and a constant, adding each scaled amount back into its entry.

name: update_three_arrays_with_increments
description: Updates three parallel arrays entry by entry with increments and limit checks, using a shared value as the running offset.

name: set_three_state_constants
description: Writes three fixed constant values into state words.

name: lookup_table_pairs_into_state
description: Looks up pairs of values from two tables using stored indices, combines them with the current position value, and updates several state words.

name: initialize_audio_tables_and_state
description: Builds a table of 31 pointers at a 30-byte stride, finds the largest value among 128 bytes, clears a memory region of that size and zeroes the global state. The facts also list audio volume registers, which the decoded body does not show.

name: reload_audio_channel_pointers
description: Advances a frame counter. When it wraps to zero it waits on a timing value and reloads the sample address registers of all four audio channels from saved words. Otherwise it calls a helper.

name: update_audio_channel_control
description: Calls four helpers, then reads a per-channel control word. When its low 12 bits are zero it restores one channel's address register and returns the word; otherwise it picks a value by a frame counter modulo three and continues the update.

name: program_channel_from_sound_table
description: Reads a nibble from a packed sound-table entry to select a 30-byte record, then loads that record's sample address, length and volume into an audio channel and updates the DMA control register.

name: tick_tracker_channel_effects
description: Per-channel tick: after a helper call, if the channel's control nibble is zero it selects a parameter from one of three sources by a frame counter modulo three. Otherwise it applies the channel's effect and writes the result back to the channel record.

name: find_period_for_note
description: Searches a 74-byte-per-row period table for the first entry at or above the channel's note value, steps back one entry when a flag bit is set, and stores the chosen period. It sets a direction flag when the chosen period is lower than the current one.

name: slide_value_toward_target
description: Moves a value by a step toward a target, up or down depending on a direction byte, and stops at the target, clearing the active count when it is reached. It returns its input unchanged when there is no target.

name: compute_waveform_modulation_offset
description: Selects a waveform value from a table, a sawtooth-style ramp or a constant depending on a type nibble, scales it by a depth nibble, applies a sign and adds the result to a base field. It then updates the phase field.

name: apply_channel_effect_command
description: Reads an effect nibble from the channel record and handles the sample-offset and position-jump style commands directly. Other effect values are dispatched through helper calls.

name: copy_low_nibble_to_field
description: Copies the low nibble of a channel byte into a second channel field. The facts describe a longer routine that touches DMA and the beam position registers, but only this short body is decoded.

name: advance_sample_pointer_on_wrap
description: Adds a table value to a counter when the high nibble of a field is non-zero. When the counter's high bit is set it resets the counter, advances a pointer within a buffer and negates the byte at the new pointer.

name: run_system_setup_with_libraries
description: Stores two arguments in globals and calls a helper, then checks a value to choose a path. Its branches call the exec library to open or close a library and set the processor status register. The facts also list interrupt and DMA control registers.

name: find_highest_set_bit_offset
description: Masks a status value and scans it from bit 31 downward until it finds a set bit, computing a jump-table offset for that bit.

name: copy_block_and_jump
description: Copies a block of bytes from one address to another, then transfers control through a jump target that the decompiler could not recover.
